#### Manna, Sarcasm, & Burritos (MSB) (Working Title\...)

*Markus lost his wife and career, and now he's struggling to maintain a basic existence. His highest hopes are for a burrito and a distracting sitcom. His financial needs lead him to take part as a paid test subject which leaves him having hallucinations of a portal to another reality. *

*Markus is then sucked into this portal with his cat Janie, only to find that she is a talking cat, and may actually be a powerful being who organized the entire event to get him to her reality. *

*After using a stick turned light-saber to kill a dangerous wolf, earning himself a magical tattoo, Markus meets Ko'Akh, a Threxan dinosaur man, and begins his journey into a world of magicians and danger, he only hopes this new world has burritos!  *

***Guiding Principle: ***

*In this science-fantasy, the use and study of magical Manna blurs the lines between science, magic, and theology. It offers new ways to explore age-old ideas inside exciting adventures.*
